subtitle: Lesson 11 · Deploying Compute & Storage

eyebrow: Azure: managed identity, not a connection string
code:
az vm identity assign \
  --resource-group rg-prod-eastus \
  --name vm-app01

az role assignment create \
  --assignee <principalId-from-identity-assign> \
  --role "Storage Blob Data Contributor" \
  --scope /subscriptions/<sub-id>/resourceGroups/rg-prod-eastus/providers/Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/ltvappstorage01
caption: Scoped to one storage account — Storage Blob Data Contributor, nothing broader.

eyebrow: AWS: the instance profile pattern, applied here
code:
aws iam create-role --role-name app-server-role \
  --assume-role-policy-document file://ec2-trust-policy.json

aws iam put-role-policy --role-name app-server-role \
  --policy-name s3-read-write \
  --policy-document file://s3-data-bucket-policy.json

aws iam create-instance-profile --instance-profile-name app-server-profile
aws iam add-role-to-instance-profile \
  --instance-profile-name app-server-profile --role-name app-server-role

aws ec2 associate-iam-instance-profile \
  --instance-id i-0123456789abcdef0 \
  --iam-instance-profile Name=app-server-profile
caption: Same pattern as the IAM fundamentals chapter — scoped to one bucket.
